QuestInfo.name: [Hayato] Back on Your Feet
QuestInfo.0: After reclaiming Honnou-ji, Princess Sakuno requests a word.
QuestInfo.1: After reclaiming Honnou-ji, Princess Sakuno requests a word.
QuestInfo.2: Princess Sakuno asked Hayato to become her vassal once again. When they agreed, Hayato felt a portion of their lost power finally returning. Princess Sakuno created an earth vein at Honnou-ji and gave them the Return skill.
